connect.channels.ari.actions_hint: Queue changes compares every enabled mapping of this connection over its days ahead and queues the days that differ; the queue sends them within a minute, or use Send now. Resend everything also sends this connection's unchanged days again. Switched-off mappings are not compared: switching one off already queued its close-out, which Send now sends.
connect.channels.ari.actions_off: This connection is switched off, so nothing can be queued or sent. Enable it under Connections first.
connect.channels.ari.caption: Availability, restrictions and prices for {codes}
connect.channels.ari.hint: What TEX would send the channel for each day — from TEX's own availability, restrictions and prices — next to what the channel last accepted. Prices come from TEX's pricing engine; this screen only shows them.
connect.channels.ari.no_mappings_hint: Add a mapping first: availability and prices are built per mapped room and rate.

connect.channels.ari.queued.one: Changes queued for {count} mapping of this connection.
connect.channels.ari.queued.other: Changes queued for {count} mappings of this connection.

connect.channels.ari.resend_body: Every day within each mapping's horizon is sent to this channel again, including the days it already has. Use it when the channel lost data.

connect.channels.ari.resend_queued.one: Every day queued again for {count} mapping of this connection.
connect.channels.ari.resend_queued.other: Every day queued again for {count} mappings of this connection.

connect.channels.empty: No channel connections at this hotel
connect.channels.empty_hint: Channel connections are created under Connect → Connections with the category “Channel manager”. Ask a hotel administrator to add one.
connect.channels.empty_hint_admin: Create one under Connections: choose the category “Channel manager”, the sandbox channel manager adapter and a secret.
connect.channels.inbound.empty_hint: Bookings, changes and cancellations the channel sends to the webhook appear here.
connect.channels.inbound.hint: Every booking message the channel sent, stored once and applied in order by the queue. A channel booking keeps the channel's price; when TEX shows no room left it is still accepted and flagged as an overbooking.
connect.channels.intro: Channel managers TEX sends availability, restrictions and prices (ARI) to and receives bookings from. Each connection maps the channel's room and rate codes to what TEX sells.
connect.channels.mapping.channel_side_hi: Exactly as the channel manager spells them. A room/rate pair is mapped once per connection.
connect.channels.mapping.contract_hint: Automatic uses the contract TEX would sell this market and sales channel with.
connect.channels.mapping.enabled_hint: When off, TEX sends the channel a close-out — nothing left to sell on any day ahead — so the channel stops selling this room and rate; once the channel has accepted it, the switched-off mapping can be deleted. Bookings the channel still sends for its codes are retried for a few hours, then marked Dead; retry them under Bookings from the channel once it is on again.
connect.channels.mapping.err_horizon: Enter a whole number from 1 to 365.
connect.channels.mapping.err_occupancies: Use whole numbers from 1 to 9 separated by commas, e.g. 1,2,3.
connect.channels.mapping.horizon_hint: How far ahead availability and prices are sent (1–365 days).
connect.channels.mapping.occupancies_hin: One price per number of adults: whole numbers 1–9, comma separated, e.g. 1,2,3.
connect.channels.mapping.rate_plan_hint: The TEX rate plan this channel rate sells, with its cancellation and payment terms.
connect.channels.mappings.delete_body: The channel must first have accepted the close-out queued when this mapping was switched off (nothing left to sell on any day). If it has not yet, send it under ARI preview → Send now until every day shows In sync, then delete.
connect.channels.mappings.delete_removes: Deleting removes the mapping, its record of the days sent to the channel and its queued jobs. Its history stays in the audit trail.
connect.channels.mappings.empty_hint: Map the room and rate codes the channel uses. Until then nothing is sent; bookings for unmapped rooms are retried for a few hours, then marked Dead — retry them under Bookings from the channel once mapped.
connect.channels.mappings.hint: Each channel room/rate code pair sells one TEX room type with a board, market, sales channel and currency. Only mapped rooms receive availability and prices.
connect.channels.mappings.saved: Mapping saved. Its availability and prices are queued for the channel.
connect.channels.mappings.saved_off: Mapping saved and switched off: its close-out is queued, so the channel stops selling it. Once the channel has accepted it (ARI preview → Send now), you can delete the mapping.
connect.channels.mappings.title: Room and rate mappings
connect.channels.no_access: Channel distribution needs the “See channel distribution” permission at this hotel.
connect.channels.not_found_hint: It does not exist or is not a channel connection of {hotel}. Switch hotel or go back to the list.
connect.channels.off.ask: A hotel administrator can enable it under Connect → Connections.
connect.channels.off.body: Nothing is sent to the channel and its webhook refuses new bookings, including sandbox ones. Messages already received are still applied.
connect.channels.off.title: This connection is switched off
connect.channels.pager.label: Pages
connect.channels.queue_dead_hint: Dead ARI jobs stopped after repeated failures and stay on record. Their days are sent again by Queue changes on the ARI preview tab and by the daily check.
connect.channels.queue_dead_link: Errors and retry in the delivery monitor
connect.channels.reconcile.in_sync: TEX and the channel are in sync
connect.channels.reconcile.intro: Checks what the channel last accepted against what TEX sells now, and the channel's bookings against TEX's bookings. Nothing is changed; the check is recorded in the audit trail.
connect.channels.reconcile.kind.ari_drif: Availability and prices not in sync
Days where the channel does not have what TEX sells now. Queue changes on the ARI preview tab sends them.
connect.channels.reconcile.kind.missing_: TEX has these bookings for this connection but the channel no longer reports them.
The channel has these bookings but TEX does not. Check their messages under Bookings from the channel: map the room and rate, then retry.
connect.channels.reconcile.kind.status_d: Cancelled on one side only. Open the TEX booking and compare it with the channel.
connect.channels.reconcile.kind.total_di: The channel's total and TEX's total are not the same. Amounts are shown as each side recorded them.
connect.channels.sandbox.cancel_rooms_hi: A cancellation carries only the booking ID; no rooms are sent.
connect.channels.sandbox.channel_name_hi: The sales channel behind the channel manager, e.g. an online travel agency.
connect.channels.sandbox.err_currency_mi: All rooms of a booking must use one currency.
connect.channels.sandbox.err_line_ref: Another room already uses this line reference.
connect.channels.sandbox.guest_hint: Optional: channels do not always share guest details.
connect.channels.sandbox.line_ref_hint: The channel's ID of this room line; keep it when modifying.
connect.channels.sandbox.provider_ref_hi: Send the same ID again as “Modified” or “Cancelled” to change that booking.
connect.channels.sandbox.result_duplicat: Message {ref} had already been received with the same content, so it was not stored again.
connect.channels.sandbox.result_hint: Message {ref} is stored. The queue applies it within a minute, or apply it now.
connect.channels.sandbox.send_off: The connection is switched off and refuses messages. Enable it under Connections first.
connect.channels.sandbox.simulation: Compose a booking as a channel would send it. TEX signs it with this connection's secret and receives it the same way as the webhook, so you can try mappings, changes, cancellations and overbooking without a real channel.
connect.channels.sandbox.status_hint.can: Cancels the booking with this ID in TEX.
connect.channels.sandbox.status_hint.mod: The full new state of an existing booking: TEX updates it to match.
connect.channels.sandbox.status_hint.new: A new booking: TEX creates it at the channel's price.
connect.channels.sandbox.title: Simulation — no real channel
connect.channels.sandbox.total_hint: The channel's price; TEX keeps it as sold.
connect.channels.sandbox.unmapped: Not mapped on this connection: TEX retries the message for a few hours, then marks it Dead; retry it under Bookings from the channel once this room and rate are mapped.
connect.channels.uncertified.body: This adapter is not certified with any real channel manager. Nothing leaves TEX: availability and prices go to a simulated channel and bookings only come from the sandbox. Real providers stay blocked until credentials and certification are in place.
connect.channels.uncertified.title: Certification blocked — sandbox only
connect.channels.webhook_hint: The channel manager posts bookings to this address, signed with the connection's secret. Unsigned or wrongly signed messages are refused.
connect.delete.body: “{label}” stops receiving reservations. Deliveries already queued for it stay in the outbox.
connect.delete.title: Delete this connection?
connect.env.production_warning: Production sends real reservations to the other system. Test in Sandbox first.
connect.field.enabled_hint: When off, nothing is sent to this connection.
connect.field.endpoint_hint: The address TEX calls, given by the other system.
connect.field.label: Name
connect.field.secret_hint: Write-only: the stored secret is never shown. Leave empty to keep it; type to replace it.
connect.field.secret_hint_new: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Used to sign requests.
connect.field.settings_json_hint: Extra options the adapter documents, such as a hotel or room mapping.
connect.fx.TCMB: TCMB — Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
connect.fx.manual: Manual rates, FX policies and rate history are managed under Rates & Contracts.
connect.fx.none: No rates fetched in the last 14 days.
connect.fx.title: FX rate providers
connect.list.empty_hint: Connect a PMS, channel manager or messaging service so reservations flow out automatically.
connect.list.hint: Systems TEX sends reservations and messages to. Select a row to edit it.
connect.list.title: Connections
connect.no_access: Integrations need the “Configure integrations” permission at this hotel.
connect.no_access_area: Connect needs the “Configure integrations” or the “See channel distribution” permission at this hotel.
connect.no_adapter: No adapter for this category is installed on this server. Enter the key your integrator gave you.
connect.outbox.empty: Nothing has been queued for delivery yet
connect.outbox.empty_hint: Reservations created, changed or cancelled here are queued for every enabled connection.
connect.outbox.hint: Every reservation change is queued and delivered with automatic retries. Failed deliveries are retried with a growing delay; after too many attempts they stop (dead) until you retry them.
connect.outbox.title: Delivery monitor
connect.status.title: Status
connect.subtitle: Integrations for {hotel}
connect.test.ok_hint: TEX reached the other system with these settings.
